name: Ayar Labs TeraPHY Optical I/O Chiplet Product Page and Specifications
notes: Official product page and specifications for the Ayar Labs TeraPHY optical I/O chiplet. Details 8 Tbps bi-directional aggregate bandwidth per chiplet across 8 full-duplex optical ports (512 Gbps per port, 4 Tbps per direction per chiplet), UCIe-compliant in-package electrical interface, 10 ns latency per chiplet, and standard CMOS manufacturing.
